title: Consequential action
purpose: Complete a consequential operation with appropriate review or real recovery.
useWhen: The action has meaningful impact on data or other people.
avoidWhen: Use direct action when application-backed recovery is appropriate; avoid ritual confirmation for trivial operations.
alternatives: Use direct action when application-backed recovery is appropriate; avoid ritual confirmation for trivial operations.
transitions: complete → undo-pending only with actual undo
applicability: The action has meaningful impact on data or other people.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; do not fabricate capabilities.
